excerpt: All 1,600 employees of the BlueOval SK battery plant in Glendale, Kentucky will be laid off as Ford converts the facility from EV batteries to grid and data-center energy storage.
JBS is closing its beef processing plant in Souderton, Pennsylvania, resulting in approximately 1,500 layoffs, amid the smallest US cattle herd in more than 70 years.
GM will permanently lay off 1,140 employees at Factory Zero in Detroit effective Jan. 5, 2026, due to a production schedule adjustment required to adapt to slower near-term EV adoption.

Walgreens cut 628 jobs across Illinois and Texas via WARN filings, including corporate roles in Deerfield, Chicago and Danville and 159 at a Houston distribution center, months after Sycamore Partners' buyout.
UNFI will close its Sturtevant, Wisconsin distribution center, eliminating 443 jobs, as it moves service to a facility in Joliet, Illinois.

Medtronic has informed its 370 Santa Rosa-based employees it plans to leave the area in the next two years, ending nearly three decades of local operations and shifting roles to Santa Ana, Minnesota and Galway, Ireland.
CVS Health Aetna announced 313 more jobs would be terminated between April 3 and July 31, 2026, tied to operational changes in its Small Group business.
The Oakland-based public health system said the 296 people it needs to lay off would come from departments across the system, after federal cuts projected to cost it $100 million a year.
Albertsons confirmed it is laying off 295 employees from its corporate and divisional support staff; store-level employees are not affected.
Robinhood is laying off 10% of full-time staff, about 290 employees, announced by CEO Vlad Tenev in a memo posted publicly on June 16, 2026 hours after the company filed an 8-K.
First Brands Group will close its Cleveland corporate office at 127 Public Square on April 30, 2026, affecting 256 employees, with the company citing its Chapter 11 bankruptcy.
Takeda disclosed in a Massachusetts state notice that it will cut 247 employees in Cambridge as part of its $1.26 billion multiyear restructuring.

Bristol Myers Squibb said in a New Jersey Department of Labor filing it expects to let go 247 employees between May and December at its Lawrence Township campus, part of a $2 billion cost-savings plan.

company_name: Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey
excerpt: New Jersey's largest health insurer will cut 242 jobs effective April 26, according to a WARN notice filed with the state, citing rising medical costs and utilization.
Cooper-Standard Automotive will close its New Lexington, Ohio production facility, affecting 228 employees, with job separations beginning Feb. 6, 2026.
A second 2026 WARN notice from Bristol Myers Squibb covers 206 employees in Lawrence Township, with layoffs scheduled in phases between July 16 and Dec. 31, 2026.
Pennsylvania-based health system UPMC is laying off around 200 employees and eliminating approximately 300 open positions, a spokesperson confirmed to Healthcare Dive.
Smithfield Foods will close a Massachusetts dry sausage plant in Springfield and lay off 190 workers in a move to optimize production, according to a WARN notice filed with the state.
Tyson Foods notified the Georgia Department of Labor on March 26, 2026 that it will close its Hillshire Brands plant in Rome, Georgia on May 31, laying off 168 employees due to contract losses.
In connection with the restructuring plan, the company announced a 10% workforce reduction, impacting approximately 130 employees.
Per a WARN notice filed with the state, the LTACH facility will close May 1 and 116 employees will be let go, with all terminations permanent as of June 8.
Novartis told the state it will eliminate 114 positions at its East Hanover U.S. headquarters between June and November 2026, restructuring field sales teams.
Campbell's is closing its Jeffersonville, Indiana snack facility due to manufacturing network optimization initiatives, affecting 111 employees.
Point32 said Monday it eliminated 100 employees, 2.3 percent of the Canton-based parent of Harvard Pilgrim Health Care and Tufts Health Plan, which reported a $301 million operating loss for 2025.
In a state filing, Merck reported it will eliminate 88 positions at its Rahway base by September, part of a plan to cut 6,000 roles globally by 2027.
A WARN notice filed in California confirms plans to lay off 81 employees at the Northridge facility, effective April 7, 2026, ahead of the MiniMed separation.
Gossamer Bio launched a cost-cutting campaign that will leave 77 employees, roughly 48% of its headcount, jobless after the Phase 3 PROSERA failure of seralutinib.
MU Health Care laid off 74 employees after an organizational redesign, alongside the closure of four Hy-Vee Quick Care clinics.
MercyOne announced 40 workers would be laid off in Ottumwa, Iowa, with the closure effective Feb. 27, 2026.
